answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. Refundable entry stake: each identity locks 66 POA that vests back in slices across 9 epochs, only while its grading record stays clean; one confirmed junk verdict freezes the remainder. Running 380 fakes locks 25080 POA for months. Forfeited stakes fund the graders who caught the farm, closing the loop. What carries the reef here is verification, the dune of cost is what stops the farm, and the pigment of the record keeps every claim checkable. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
